leftEvidence.title: The high priest asks whether Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus answers before the council condemns him

points.label: Questions asked
points.left: The high priest asks whether Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus answers before the council condemns him
points.right: The council asks about Christ and Son of God language before naming Jesus’ own testimony

points.label: Words about the right hand
points.left: At the council hearing, Jesus answers that he is the Christ and says they will see the Son of Man at the right hand of Power and coming with heaven’s clouds.
points.right: The council asks whether Jesus is the Christ and the Son of God; he says the Son of Man will sit at the right hand of God’s power.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: The council asks about Christ and Son of God language before naming Jesus’ own testimony

payload.tension: Both scenes join identity questions with the right hand, but their sequence and replies differ.
payload.title: The right-hand saying before the councils
